sections.title: Identity and form
sections.text: The catalogue's Campanula entry is Campanula rotundifolia, harebell, not the whole genus. This low perennial usually reaches about 30 cm. Rounded basal leaves contrast with narrow stem leaves; blue bell-shaped flowers are around 2 cm long and are followed by a capsule.

sections.title: Uses and image
sections.text: No reliable food use was established for this profile. The plate's two leaf forms, blue bells and capsule match the species.
